newsitem.title: CHINA: China 96/97 sugar output hit 6.604 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China 96/97 sugar output hit 6.604 mln tonnes.

text.p: China produced 6.604 million tonnes of sugar in the 1996/97 crushing season (October-April), up by 376,000 tonnes from the last season, an official said on Tuesday.

Of the total output, 5.214 million tonnes were from sugarcane and 1.39 million tonnes from sugar beets, said an official of the China Sugar Association under the China General Association of Light Industry.
Most of the gains in sugar output were from the southern provinces of Yunnan and Guangxi, northwestern Xinjiang and northern Inner Mongolia, the Economic Daily said without giving further details.
The government would continue to limit sugar imports and curb smuggling to boost sales of domestic sugar producers, the newspaper said.
Chinese sugar producers had been hard hit by sluggish prices brought about by smuggling in the past. Officials have said about 2.0 million tonnes were illegally imported in 1995.
